_comment: Book catalog for Bookly recommendation engine

BOOK-001.title: Killing Floor
BOOK-001.author: Lee Child
BOOK-001.description: Ex-military policeman Jack Reacher arrives in a small Georgia town and finds himself caught up in a web of conspiracy and murder.

BOOK-002.title: Die Trying
BOOK-002.author: Lee Child
BOOK-002.description: Jack Reacher is kidnapped along with an FBI agent and becomes entangled in a violent militia plot.

BOOK-003.title: Tripwire
BOOK-003.author: Lee Child
BOOK-003.description: Reacher is tracked down by a private detective looking for his help, leading to a dangerous investigation into his past.

BOOK-004.title: The Black Echo
BOOK-004.author: Michael Connelly
BOOK-004.description: LAPD detective Harry Bosch investigates the murder of a fellow Vietnam veteran found in a drainpipe.

BOOK-005.title: The Black Ice
BOOK-005.author: Michael Connelly
BOOK-005.description: Harry Bosch investigates a cop's suicide that leads to a dangerous drug cartel.

BOOK-006.title: The Concrete Blonde
BOOK-006.author: Michael Connelly
BOOK-006.description: Harry Bosch must face his past actions when a serial killer case he thought closed is reopened.

BOOK-007.title: The Lincoln Lawyer
BOOK-007.author: Michael Connelly
BOOK-007.description: Defense attorney Mickey Haller works out of his Lincoln Town Car, defending clients in Los Angeles.

BOOK-008.title: Foundation
BOOK-008.author: Isaac Asimov
BOOK-008.description: A monumental work about the fall of a galactic empire and the scientists who work to preserve knowledge.

BOOK-009.title: Foundation and Empire
BOOK-009.author: Isaac Asimov
BOOK-009.description: The Foundation faces its greatest challenge as a mysterious mutant threatens its plans.

BOOK-010.title: Second Foundation
BOOK-010.author: Isaac Asimov
BOOK-010.description: The search for the mysterious Second Foundation reaches its climax.

BOOK-011.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
BOOK-011.author: Philip K. Dick
BOOK-011.description: In a post-apocalyptic future, bounty hunter Rick Deckard hunts rogue androids while questioning the nature of humanity.

BOOK-012.title: The Man in the High Castle
BOOK-012.author: Philip K. Dick
BOOK-012.description: An alternate history where the Axis powers won World War II and divided America.

BOOK-013.title: Ubik
BOOK-013.author: Philip K. Dick
BOOK-013.description: A mind-bending tale of reality manipulation in a world where the dead can be kept in a state of half-life.

BOOK-014.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
BOOK-014.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
BOOK-014.description: An envoy visits a planet where the inhabitants can change their gender, exploring themes of identity and society.

BOOK-015.title: The Dispossessed
BOOK-015.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
BOOK-015.description: A physicist from an anarchist moon colony travels to the capitalist planet it orbits, exploring political philosophy.

BOOK-016.title: Neuromancer
BOOK-016.author: William Gibson
BOOK-016.description: A washed-up computer hacker is hired for one last job in this seminal cyberpunk novel.

BOOK-017.description: In the Sprawl trilogy's second book, three interconnected stories explore corporate espionage and AI.

BOOK-018.title: Mona Lisa Overdrive
BOOK-018.author: William Gibson
BOOK-018.description: The final book in the Sprawl trilogy brings together characters from the previous novels.

BOOK-019.title: Red Rabbit
BOOK-019.author: Tom Clancy
BOOK-019.description: Jack Ryan's early days at the CIA during the Cold War as he uncovers a Soviet plot.

BOOK-020.title: The Hunt for Red October
BOOK-020.author: Tom Clancy
BOOK-020.description: A Soviet submarine captain attempts to defect to the United States with his officers and his submarine.

BOOK-021.title: Patriot Games
BOOK-021.author: Tom Clancy
BOOK-021.description: Jack Ryan intervenes in an IRA attack in London, making himself a target.

BOOK-022.title: Clear and Present Danger
BOOK-022.author: Tom Clancy
BOOK-022.description: Jack Ryan uncovers a secret war against Colombian drug cartels.

BOOK-032.description: Life in Pompeii before the catastrophic volcanic eruption of Mount Vesuvius.

BOOK-034.author: Graham Hancock
BOOK-034.description: Further investigation into the lost civilization theory with new archaeological evidence.

BOOK-035.author: Neal Stephenson

BOOK-036.author: Neal Stephenson
BOOK-036.description: Two timelines interweave cryptography in WWII with a modern quest to create a data haven.

BOOK-037.title: Seveneves

BOOK-038.title: Ready Player Two

BOOK-039.title: Ready Player One

BOOK-039.description: In a dystopian future, people escape reality through a virtual universe called the OASIS.

BOOK-040.title: The Bourne Supremacy

BOOK-042.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
BOOK-042.author: Robert Ludlum
BOOK-042.description: Bourne's final confrontation with the legendary assassin Carlos the Jackal.

BOOK-044.description: A philosophical treatise on the relationship between reality, symbols, and society.

BOOK-054.description: Ancient Chinese military treatise on strategy, tactics, and leadership.
